title: MERGE-benchmark: data and code for benchmarking genomic foundation and sequence-to-function models for variant pathogenicity prediction
description:
Data and code for benchmarking DNA language, evolutionary, protein and sequence-to-function models on four variant classes — coding missense SNVs (n = 4,289), splicing SNVs (n = 35,015), noncoding SNVs (n = 86,829) and short non-SNVs (n = 36,862) — under fixed chromosome-held-out folds, and for MERGE (Model Ensemble for Ranking Genomic Effects), which integrates fixed model-derived features. AlphaGenome is evaluated independently and through a fixed score average; its outputs are not used for supervised feature selection or model fitting.

The archive contains the dataset-construction and feature-extraction code, the four feature tables, the modelling and statistics code, out-of-fold predictions and result tables (manuscript Tables 1–10), the comparison with established predictors, the BRCA1 saturation genome editing validation, the deployable models and the manuscript figures.

Code and models: MIT. Derived tables and figures: CC BY 4.0. AlphaGenome percentile table: CC BY-NC 4.0. Third-party scores and upstream resources keep their own terms; see README.
